_meta.adr: ADR-022 — opt every shillinq bookkeeping schema into OR's audit-trail-immutable abstraction; no app-local audit tables
_meta.description: Audit-trail opt-in fragment for every shillinq bookkeeping register per REQ-AT-001 of capability bookkeeping-audit-trail. Adds x-openregister-audit-trail: { enabled: true } to every bookkeeping schema so OR's audit-trail-immutable captures actor + before/after + timestamp + hash chain on every create / update / lifecycle transition / delete. Per ADR-022 D2 no app-local audit table is authored. PO-3-way schemas (PurchaseOrder, GoodsReceiptNote, SupplierInvoice, ThreeWayMatch) are already opted-in via bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way-11-audit-trail-export.json — they are deliberately omitted here. Non-bookkeeping schemas (bookings, inventory, notifications) are out of scope per REQ-AT-001.
